- The Missouri State Lady Bears are the women's basketball team of Missouri State University, located in Springfield, Missouri.

- In the 2014-15 season, the Lady Bears competed in the Missouri Valley Conference.

- Their head coach during the 2014-15 season was Kellie Harper, who is still the current head coach of the team.

- The Lady Bears finished the 2014-15 season with a record of 17-15 overall and 9-9 in conference play.

- They qualified for the 2015 Missouri Valley Conference Tournament, where they were eliminated in the quarterfinal round.

- Key players on the 2014-15 roster included senior forward Hillary Chvatal and sophomore guard Liza Fruendt.
